thread:
alex_sales: Heads up — Acme's POC failures: they hit 403 on POST /v1/generate while using our sandbox. Demo in ~2 hours. Anyone free to triage?

nina_eng: Can you share the curl + response body? 403 often means project binding or missing scope.

alex_sales: They sent: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_ABC' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{\"model\":\"rwx-7b\",\"input\":\"hi\"}'`
Response: `{\"error\":{\"code\":403,\"message\":\"Forbidden: invalid project binding\"}}`

sam_ops: That error => token not bound to project or X-Project-ID header missing. Ask them to decode JWT claims and paste `project` and `scopes`.

alex_sales: They returned claims: `{\"sub\":\"svc:acme\",\"project\":\"acme-poc\",\"scopes\":[\"embeddings:read\"]}`

lee_support: Ok scope only embeddings:read. Inference needs `inference:invoke`. We'll generate a temp service key with inference scope and bind to acme-poc. Also remind them to include `X-Project-ID: acme-poc`.

maria_security: Side note: if they want keys rotated into their KMS we can coordinate. Also shared snippet for the security questionnaire about audit logs retention.

nina_eng: I created a temp key `sk_temp_9z` scoped `[inference:invoke,embeddings:read]` bound to project=acme-poc and posted secure link. Ticket SLS-1129. ops_bot: [bot] service_key created sk_temp_9z by nina_eng for acme-poc.

alex_sales: They tried new key + X-Project-ID but saw 401 with `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer error=\"invalid_token\", error_description=\"signature verification failed\"`.

sam_ops: Usually copy/paste error or env var included extra quotes/newline. Ask them to `echo -n \"$TOKEN\" | wc -c` and ensure length matches provided key. Also have them curl with `-v` and paste back headers.

lee_support: They fixed their export (removed trailing newline) and retried. 200 OK and generation works. Demo confirmed.

alex_sales: Great — demo green. Last Q from Acme: will hosted trial be enough or should they plan Dedicated for low latency?

nina_eng: For demos hosted is fine. For production with tight p99 latency and high throughput, recommend Dedicated reserved pools. Sent a short cost/next-steps DM.

maria_security: Sent the security questionnaire excerpt. Follow up if they want KMS integration.

nina_eng: Root cause summary: token lacked inference scope + missing X-Project-ID; secondary: token copy had extra whitespace causing signature error. Logged to SLS-1129. :white_check_mark:
